response.original_title: 【Helpful™-Guide】 How to communicate on Royal Caribbean Cruise?
response.overview: You can communicate on a Royal Caribbean cruise using the Royal Caribbean App chat feature, purchasing a VOOM internet package, or using stateroom phones.  Free & Low-Cost Onboard Options  Royal Caribbean App Chat: Use the free guest chat feature inside the app while connected to the ship's Wi-Fi network (no internet package required). Opinions on Reddit and Facebook groups are mixed, as some users find it convenient while others report notification delays. Stateroom Phones: Call other cabins directly for free by dialing their stateroom number +1-855-732-4023 (US/Canada) or +44-289-708-0062 (UK). Ship-to-Shore Calls: Make calls from your room to land for $7.95 per minute billed to your SeaPass account
